mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the drainage network to the supplied arm was most worthwhile: the planned matched views connect lymph return to preventing fluid buildup without implying filtration stops.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: tracing the fluid from tissue spaces back to a vein and seeing its role in fluid balance gave the assembly a clear biological payoff. The available evidence is still text and illustration plans, not finished artwork or evidence of student comprehension.
